title: NASA Remembers Its Fallen Heroes 2023
description: NASA remembers the crews of Apollo 1, space shuttles Challenger and Columbia during the agency's Day of Remembrance on Jan. 26, 2023, the 20th anniversary of the Columbia accident. NASA's Day of Remembrance honors members of the NASA family who lost their lives while furthering the cause of exploration and discovery.

transcript.text: Every January we at NASA have a day of remembrance
to encourage reflection
throughout NASA, throughout our country, throughout indeed, the world.
It’s a day to pause, to remember,
and to uplift the legacies of the NASA family members
who gave their lives to advance the cause of exploration.
The crew of Apollo one,
then Challenger,
then Columbia,
and the many other astronauts that died
while they were actually training.
We will never forget these astronauts, nor
all those who have lost their lives in the pursuit of discovery.
And so on this day of remembrance, we honor
and try to better understand
our place in this huge, huge universe
and our attempts at discovery
and exploration in it.
These astronauts all achieved the once impossible dream to soar
in the cosmos
and to explore the heavens.
And their families have suffered,
and they have our deepest respect.
Every day at NASA
we have an opportunity, we have a responsibility
to carry forth their memories.
And by taking the next giant leap
we want to keep alive their legacies.
By meeting every challenge head on
we want to remember their legacies.
As we push the edge of the envelope
of human achievement in this new era of exploration,
we must always continue to embrace the core value of safety.
It's an institutional and it's an individual responsibility.
This is and always will be,
as we reflect, a very solemn day on the sacrifice
that was made by a bunch of very,
very brave adventurers.
It's also a day
of remembrance, of extreme gratitude.
We are thankful
that NASA's fallen adventurers shared their lives with us.
They made life on this earth better
and today and every day, we at NASA are still united
in that shared pursuit
of exploration and discovery.
And may we carry their spirit
and those of all who have given their lives
in the name of exploration.
May we carry their spirit with us
as we venture out
to the Moon,
to Mars,
and beyond.
